title: The Seed Helicopter on the Step
youtube_title: The Seed Helicopter on the Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Sable finds a seed spinning down like a helicopter. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Sable shows Hester how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
